77.0: In the Jerusalem Talmud (Yerushalmi), it raises an objection: But it is written, 'And no man shall be in the Tent of Meeting' [when the High Priest enters on Yom Kippur] (Leviticus 16:17), and we interpret this to mean even those of whom it is written, "and their faces were like the face of a man". And it answers: It was the honor of the Holy One, blessed be He."
